items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Chuck Beatty was the one who got me out [of the bus accident].

ctx.x: Harold Logan. So Chuck, they had a part of the band. We were at the Royal Theater in Baltimore, and it was a big opening. So Logan decided to treat the band to some drinks at a club down the street from the Royal. So Logan didn't drink, but he had a few drinks that night, because everybody was happy, because the opening night was so great. So Chuck said, well, here's my time to get a raise.
